stage: Written before new v3 diagnostic computations; v2 forecast and aggregate metrics already known
purpose: Challenge calibration and ensemble interpretation without selecting new parameters or generating a changed target forecast
input: deliverables/20261109T144101Z-v2/calculations: fixed 239 held-out 2026 BO5 predictions and raw selected-family predictions
subsets: 46 international main-event BO5s defined by original league identity
diagnostics: Fixed-forecast Brier/logloss and paired differences: blend versus each component and coinflip, calibrated versus raw within each component
One-parameter unpenalized symmetric logistic slope fit to 2026 only as a diagnostic, not applied to the target
Error/probability correlation of fixed family forecasts

uncertainty.method: Empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles of tournament-block resamples; descriptive, with cross-event team dependence and few international blocks retained as limitations

decisionBoundary: No change solely because a selected subset or alternative component has a nicer score. A strong diagnostic problem may justify a separately preregistered model-development revision with its own evaluation, not immediate 2026 recalibration of the target.
